name: congress-avenue-walk-blocks
_comment: TICK-346 (#346). The blocks the 2026-09-04 walk actually covered, derived from the walk's own evidence rather than assumed: the 19 street addresses recorded on foot or read off a transom in data/entrance_identification.json (geocoded through OSM/Nominatim, committed as data/external/entrance_anchors.json) together with the catalogue locations of the six entrances that already resolved. That evidence hull runs 30.263882..30.269652 N and -97.746043..-97.741761 E; the box below is the hull padded by 40 m on every side, which is the map's own match distance, so any business a walked door could legitimately match to is inside the swept area. The committed demo-area box (src/frontdoor/demo_area.json) is unchanged - it still names the Second Street district, and this sweep merges into the same catalogue.
